bullets.text: Self-Driving Cars Arrive - **Wayve** and **Uber** plan Level 4 autonomous robotaxi trials in London by 2026.
Apple's Developer Lawsuit - **Apple** denied appeal in a £1B lawsuit over abusive commission practices for app developers.
New App Review Guidelines - **Apple** tightens rules on sharing personal data with third-party AI in updated guidelines.
Apple Wallet Upgrades - **Apple Wallet** introduces Digital ID and AI order tracking in iOS 26, enhancing user experience.
AI Group Chat Feature - **OpenAI** rolls out group chat functionality in **ChatGPT**, enhancing user interaction capabilities.
Apple Halves Mini App Commissions - **Apple** launches a program reducing commissions for mini app developers to 15%.
Emergency SOS Expansion - **Apple** launches Emergency SOS via satellite feature in Mexico for iPhone and Apple Watch users.
Blue Origin's New Glenn Success - **Blue Origin** successfully lands its New Glenn rocket and deploys NASA spacecraft.
Uber Pilots Video Recording - **Uber** tests in-app video recording for drivers in India to deter misconduct.
AI Investment Shifts - VCs adapt to new investment strategies for AI startups, focusing on unique growth metrics.
